page.overview:
Who is Angel?

Angel is a member of the in Tales of the TMNT, serving as co-underboss along with .

Angel comes up past 's shoulders, which makes her a fairly tall young woman. She wears boots and dark slacks with elastic straps on each thigh. When she took sais, she kept them tucked in the straps. She also wears a bomber jacket with a sherpa collar and spikes attached to the shoulders. Under the jacket is a sleeveless white shirt with purple wings on the front. She wears a choker around her neck and has a heart pierced by a knife tattooed on her left bicep, as well as a pair of wings tattooed on her back. Her hair, which is dark brown with a large purple topcoat, is often covered by the neck gaiter she wears, though she does not cover her face.

Hun and Angel are put in charge of operations at Gently Plucked Chicken Company, the Dragons' temporary base. The pair were put in charge of the Purple Dragons by their boss, .

After is captured by the Dragons and chained to the floor of the chicken factory, Angel arrives on her motorcycle and she and Hun bicker about the noise scaring the chickens versus Angel not wanting her bike left out to get stolen. Raph takes advantage of their momentary distraction to break the floorboard holding the chain and swinging it around to try to hit Hun, but he dodges and it hits Boomerang Dragon instead. Angel follows up by sliding to attack Raph, and Hun leaps up and brings Bricky down on Raph's plastron, injuring his already-broken ribs.
